title: Amistad, infancia y filosofía: experiencias en los campamentos filosóficos Friendship, Childhood, and Philosophy: Experiences at Philosophy Camps Amizade, infância e filosofia: experiências nos acampamentos filosóficos
abstract: El presente artículo analiza el concepto de amistad desde una perspectiva filosófica en relación con la infancia y el aspecto educativo, destacando su importancia en los procesos de formación humana. Para ello, se retoman aportes de autores clásicos y contemporáneos que permiten comprender la amistad más allá de una relación cotidiana, reconociéndola como una experiencia ética, formativa y relacional. Asimismo, se reflexiona sobre su vínculo con la educación, especialmente en los campamentos filosóficos desarrollados en el departamento de Boyacá, entendidos como espacios pedagógicos que promueven el diálogo, la reflexión y la construcción colectiva del conocimiento. En estos escenarios, la amistad favorece la participación, el pensamiento crítico y el fortalecimiento de vínculos entre niños y jóvenes de diversos contextos. Finalmente, el artículo plantea que la amistad constituye un elemento fundamental en la formación filosófica y pedagógica, al contribuir a la creación de experiencias educativas basadas en la convivencia, el reconocimiento del otro y la construcción de comunidad.

title: Reflejos de lo femenino: infancia y ascendencia Espelhos do feminino: infância e ancestralidade Reflections of the Feminine: Childhood and Ancestry
abstract: Este artículo propone reflexiones sobre un ejercicio filosófico realizado con niños, niñas y jóvenes en el X Campamento Filosófico: Estética e Infancia, Arte de la Existencia, en la ciudad de Duitama, departamento de Boyacá, Colombia, en agosto de 2025. Este ejercicio se planteó en el marco de la actividad Espiral del Pensamiento. Propusimos una experiencia con diferentes espejos en la que cada niño, niña y joven fue invitado a mirarse a sí mismo y a lo que lo constituye como sujeto en constante construcción. Esta mirada buscó, particularmente en este ejercicio filosófico, lo femenino que existe en nosotros, en el sentido de la ascendencia que nos formó y que sigue presente en los diversos rasgos de mi yo. Como referencias para la escritura, autores como Foucault, Butler, Krenak y Kohan nos ayudaron a problematizar la búsqueda de tiempos y espacios en los que podamos ser activos y únicos en la manera en que construimos nuestra relación con nosotros mismos y con los otros.

title: Pensar e interrogar: tejiendo espirales de vida Thinking and Questioning: Weaving Spirals of Life Pensar e questionar: tecendo espirais de vida
abstract: Este artículo de reflexión analiza los campamentos filosóficos como experiencias educativas que transforman el aprendizaje en una vivencia reflexiva, bajo la perspectiva de Filosofía e Infancia, donde docentes y niños construyen sentidos desde el asombro y la cotidianidad. El campamento se analiza como una experiencia narrativa donde pensar e interrogarse se configuran como formas de habitar el mundo, integrando la filosofía a la vida diaria mediante gestos, preguntas y silencios. A través del diálogo y la convivencia, se generan procesos que fortalecen la escucha, la sensibilidad y el pensamiento crítico. Finalmente, este proceso transforma la práctica educativa, reafirmando una educación más humana y situada. En conclusión, esta propuesta sostiene que la filosofía de la educación en diferentes contextos trasciende el aula convencional. Al fomentar el pensamiento crítico y la educación intercultural, se abre un espacio donde la narración deja de ser una tarea para convertirse en un acto vital. Es precisamente en el tiempo libre donde el estudiante logra tejer experiencias, transformando el interrogar constante en una herramienta de subjetivación que dota de sentido su existencia y

title: A arte antropofágica de fazer perguntas: pensar e equipar-se com o outro El arte antropofágico de hacer preguntas: pensar y dotarse de recursos junto al otro The anthropophagic art of asking questions: thinking and equipping oneself with the other
abstract: Este texto emerge de diferentes exercícios filosóficos realizados no Acampamento Filosófico na Colômbia, em sua 8ª e 10ª edições. Em especial, consideramos a espiral do pensamento intitulada “A arte de fazer perguntas: pensar e devorar com o Abaporu”, em que a arte de Tarsila do Amaral, considerada uma das principais artistas modernistas latino-americanas, e as crianças se encontraram para fazer nascer perguntas, deslocamentos, riscos e modos outros de problematizar a relação entre o corpo e o pensamento. A partir de uma perspectiva de filosofia e infância, pensamos em alguns gestos que poderiam servir como dimensões importantes para darmos nome aos acontecimentos que emergiram dessa experiência, sendo eles: perguntar; olhar; caminhar; ler e escrever; equipar-se. Esses gestos buscam ensaiar os encontros consigo, com os outros e com o mundo, na invenção de modos de existência mais afirmativos nesse tempo e espaço comum que se abre para pensarmos radicalmente a vida, que são os Acampamentos Filosóficos.

title: Vida estudiosa. El campamento filosófico y la pregunta por el ser maestro The Life of a Scholar: The Philosophical Camp and the Question of What It Means to Be a Teacher Vida de estudante. O acampamento filosófico e a questão de ser professor
abstract: El presente artículo explora la experiencia de enseñanza y formación que moviliza el décimo Campamento Filosófico “Estética e Infancia: arte de la existencia”, organizado por la Red de Filosofía e Infancia y los Grupos AION y GIFSE. A partir de entrevistas, tematizaciones e identificación de categorías se enfoca tanto en la pregunta por el/la maestra como en la noción de “vida estudiosa”. En general, el campamento filosófico es ideado como dispositivo que libera tiempo y espacio, habilita “espirales de pensamiento” e intensifica la experiencia filosófica en cuanto experiencia de formación. En su desarrollo se discuten cuatro dimensiones clave: el lugar del maestro como amateur apasionado y provocador; la autoridad entendida a partir del cultivo de la palabra; la importancia del silencio, la atención y la escucha como prácticas pedagógicas; y, por último, la escritura e investigación como ejes de renovación constante del ser maestro. A partir de estos ejes de discusión se oye resonar la pregunta por la escuela y los nexos que tiende con el campamento filosófico en cuanto cronotopo liberado dispuesto para el cultivo de la vida estudiosa.

title: La amorosidad como virtud ético-política en la relación maestro-comunidad-infancia Compassion as an Ethical-Political Virtue in the Relationship Between Teachers, the Community, and Children A bondade como virtude ético-política na relação professor-comunidade-crianças
abstract: Este artículo surge de la reflexión de dos maestras en educación infantil que interrogan su formación pedagógica ante el vínculo con la comunidad. Se inscribe en una investigación narrativa con enfoque cualitativo, desarrollada en la Maestría en Educación de la Universidad Pedagógica y Tecnológica de Colombia (UPTC), e inspirada en Paulo Freire (2002), quien concibe la amorosidad como virtud ética y política del acto educativo. La problemática abordada se relaciona con el desconocimiento del saber comunitario como parte de la labor docente, lo que limita la educación al espacio escolar físico y relega la amorosidad como categoría pedagógica y política. El objetivo es argumentar que la amorosidad constituye una virtud ética‑política en la relación maestro-comunidad-infancia, transformando los espacios educativos en territorios de encuentro, saberes, sensibilidad y cuidado. El proceso investigativo se sustentó en registros cualitativos —diarios de viaje, testimonios y conversaciones— y se configuró como una cartografía poética categorial que organiza cuatro territorios simbólicos: ética relacional, palabra compartida, praxis política y libertad. Estos hallazgos revelan que la infanci

title: Subjetividad política de líderes escolares en San Cristóbal, Medellín: un contexto de violencia Political Subjectivity of School Leaders in San Cristóbal, Medellín: A Context of Violence Subjetividade política dos líderes escolares em San Cristóbal, Medellín: um contexto de violência
abstract: This research project explores the configuration of political subjectivity among certain students in a public educational institution located in a territory marked by violence and precarity. The study, grounded in the analysis of 80 prior works, draws on the theoretical frameworks of several authors such as Deleuze, Guattari and Tassin, particularly their understanding of subjectivity as a dynamic process of “subjection”. The political subjectivity of these school leaders is articulated through three interdependent axes: the school as a space for political engagement, resistance and territory, violence and precarization. Ultimately, the research argues that student leadership in some schools of the San Cristóbal district embodies an 'active' political subjectivity, this evidences a process of resistance and agency that counteracts some predominant narratives of passivity, little participation or no youth agency.

title: El campamento filosófico como experiencia de retorno: Infancias, tiempos y pensamientos The philosophical camp as a return experience: Childhoods, Times, and Thoughts O acampamento filosófico como experiência de retorno: infâncias, tempos e pensamentos
abstract: This article reflects on the philosophy camp as an experience of return, understood not as a one-time event but as a process that extends over time, through the writings, and into the lives of the children who participate in it. Drawing on the experience of the 9th and 10th Philosophy Camps, held in Colombia, the article analyzes how the philosophical experience unfolds in a spiral, producing shifts that persist beyond the camp’s formal conclusion. The study takes the writing and exchange of letters among children and teachers as the central axis of analysis, understanding them as spaces for elaboration, continuity, and re-enunciation of the lived experience. Based on this correspondence, as well as on drawings and books created by the children, the study discusses the ways in which the camp remains in motion. In dialogue with the perspective of Philosophy and Childhood, concepts such as experience, lived time, imagination, and questioning are mobilized as formative forces that sustain thought in motion. The analysis explores images such as “jaguar childhood” and “childhood on horseback,” proposing them as modes of relating to time, territory, and experience. It concludes that the

title: Revisión documental: educación y formación bajo la óptica de las tecnologías emergentes Literature Review: Education and Training from the Perspective of Emerging Technologies Revisão da literatura: educação e formação na perspetiva das tecnologias emergentes
abstract: This article examines the integration of emerging technologies into the classroom within the field of education and training, approached from the perspective of the economies of attention; furthermore, the literature review reflects the current state of the art of the project “In Search of Attention: Digital Devices in Schools, A View from the Educational Landscape,” a thesis submitted for a Master’s degree in Education. This article is developed as a documentation exercise, which utilizes the Publindex indexing system. The writing process is carried out through document commentary, thereby integrating the compiled documentation into a single text. The findings highlight that certain digital strategies have demonstrated improvements in students’ adaptability within school settings; similarly, it is acknowledged that the effective use of these resources in educational processes is determined by the digital literacy levels of tutors and teachers; likewise, it is emphasized that emerging technologies are employed as a mechanism to capture users’ attention.

title: La poesía como experiencia filosófica en la infancia: versos que florecen Poetry as a Philosophical Experience in Childhood: Versesthat Bloom A Poesia como Experiência Filosófica na Infância: Versos que Desabrocham
abstract: En el marco de la décima versión del Campamento Filosófico en Boyacá, este artículo examina la poesía como experiencia filosófica en la infancia a partir de la propuesta pedagógica “Versos que florecen”. El estudio tuvo como objetivo comprender los sentidos formativos que emergen cuando la palabra poética se configura como dispositivo estético y no como recurso didáctico instrumental. La investigación se desarrolló desde un enfoque cualitativo de carácter hermenéutico-interpretativo, bajo la modalidad de sistematización reflexiva de experiencia pedagógica. La producción de información incluyó observación participante, registros de campo, producciones escriturales y gráficas infantiles, así como conversaciones colectivas. El análisis inductivo permitió identificar núcleos de sentido relacionados con el poema como dispositivo estético, la escritura como forma de percepción y la infancia como territorio de pensamiento. Los resultados evidencian que, en un ambiente no evaluativo centrado en la exploración sensible, la poesía favorece desplazamientos subjetivos y la emergencia de preguntas éticas y existenciales. Se concluye que la experiencia poética no enseña filosofía como contenido,

title: CUDEPAZ: cultura y deporte para la construcción de un territorio de paz CUDEPAZ: Culture and sport for the construction of a territory of peace CUDEPAZ: cultura e desporto para a construção de um território de paz
abstract: This study, the result of an investigation, aimed to analyze the role of cultural and sporting activities in building a territory of peace among ninth, tenth, and eleventh-grade students at the IETAR Institution in Santana, Boyacá. The research employed a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative and qualitative methods. It was non-experimental and cross-sectional, with an exploratory scope. Data collection techniques included surveys, field notes, and document analysis, providing a comprehensive view of the current situation regarding conflict dynamics at the IETAR educational institution. Data analysis revealed that conflict dynamics within the institution are strongly influenced by factors such as a lack of effective communication, poor emotional management, and the absence of adequate spaces for peaceful conflict resolution. The study highlights the need for the sustained implementation of educational programs that integrate sports and culture as means to strengthen coexistence and peace within the school environment, thus contributing to building a territory of peace in the community.

title: Inclusión educativa: perspectiva Filosofía e Infancia. Una mirada documental Educational Inclusion: A Philosophy and Childhood Perspective. A Documentary Perspective Inclusão educativa: uma perspetiva da Filosofia e da Infância. Uma análise documental
abstract: This article presents a documentary review focused on educational inclusion from the perspective of philosophy and childhood in Latin American contexts. Through an analysis of recent research, four main areas are examined: approaches to educational inclusion in the region, contributions of philosophical thought in childhood, pedagogical experiences that integrate philosophy as an inclusive strategy, and proposals that articulate these elements into concrete practices. The results reveal common ground regarding the formative value of philosophy to strengthen participation, autonomy, and critical thinking in children. However, tensions also emerge between theoretical discourse and the real possibilities of implementation in educational systems marked by structural inequalities. It is concluded that philosophy, understood both as a pedagogical attitude and as curricular content, provides tools to build fairer schools, as long as there is effective articulation among educational policies, teacher training, and local contexts. This review invites us to rethink the place of childhood as an active subject of thought and educational transformation.

title: Capacitación docente en metodología didáctica interactiva en la Corporación Universitaria Autónoma Nariño Teacher Training in Interactive Teaching Methods at the Nariño Autonomous University Corporation Formação de professores em métodos de ensino interativos na Corporação Universitária Autónoma de Nariño
abstract: This article examined the influence of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) on higher education, with an emphasis on their impact on teaching methodology. Through an analysis of changes in teaching processes, the article highlighted the need to update pedagogical practices by integrating technological tools that promote a more interactive and student-centered approach.The research aimed to design a training course in interactive teaching methodology for faculty members at the Autonomous University Corporation of Nariño, Ipiales campus. The methodology adopted was qualitative in approach, with a descriptive design based on the Participatory Action Research (PAR) model. Among the expected outcomes was the strengthening of the faculty’s digital competencies, with a view to improving the quality of teaching and fostering more dynamic and accessible classes. The conclusions indicated that teacher training is a key factor for the effective implementation of ICT in the classroom, promoting more meaningful and flexible learning.lity to use technological tools is the key to designing more active classes (Rodríguez, 2019).

title: Práctica profesional y desarrollo de competencias transversales del nutricionista dietista Professional Practice and the Development of Cross-Functional Skills for Registered Dietitians A prática profissional e o desenvolvimento de competências multifuncionais para nutricionistas
abstract: Introduction: The development of cross-cutting competencies is key to the professional practice of registered dietitians in diverse settings. Objective: To evaluate the contribution of the professional practicums in the Nutrition and Dietetics program at the University of Antioquia to the strengthening of cross-cutting competencies. Materials and methods: A multidimensional methodological design (structure, process, outcome) and triangulation of methods. Faculty advisors, students, and graduates participated. Results: No defined mechanisms were found to objectively evaluate cross-cutting competencies. Greater development was identified in time management and oral communication. The advisor and the practice settings influence the development of competencies. Discussion: Teamwork, time management, and communication are important because they facilitate better outcomes for comprehensive training. Conclusion: Specific methodologies that promote, develop, and evaluate cross-cutting competencies throughout the training process must be integrated.

title: El fenómeno del bullying comprendido a través del INSEBULL en dos instituciones educativas del SEABs Instituciones Educativas del SEAB The Bullying Phenomenon Understood through INSEBULL in Two Educational Institutions of the SEAB O Fenômeno Bullying Compreendido a través do INSEBULL em Duas Instituições de Ensino da SEAB
abstract: Due to a lack of understanding, information, interaction, and respect for difference, problematic situations arise in school environments that lead to different types of educational violence and bullying. Therefore, this study delved into analyzing the impact of cultural dynamics and educational diversity on the manifestation of school violence in the educational community, as well as analyzing the phenomenon of bullying among students. The research was implemented in two educational institutions of the Archdiocese Educational System (SEAB). The Bullying Monitoring and Evaluation Instrument (INSEBULL) was used to collect data from students in grades 8 through 11. A phenomenological-hermeneutic paradigm was adopted with a non-experimental, cross-sectional, qualitative design. The results show that students reported feeling excluded and having a limited social network. Furthermore, it was identified that peers may not always be aware of the social exclusion experienced by some students, which can lead to a lower rate of victim identification using this instrument. In conclusion, the identified problems demonstrate the urgent need to implement educational programs that address bullyin

title: A Model of Popular Participation: Reflections on Development as Freedom Un modelo de participación popular: reflexiones sobre el desarrollo como libertad Um modelo de participação popular: reflexões sobre o desenvolvimento como liberdade
abstract: According to the Indian economist and philosopher Amartya Sen, human freedoms are both means and ends for the development of nations. One of the most important freedoms in this regard is that of popular participation in public-private partnerships, PPPs, which improves the effectiveness of these projects. Offering a new perspective to the existing literature and based on the approach of development as freedom, this paper presents a theoretical model of public governance with the private sector and society, which could be applied in a policy of popular participation. This model demonstrates that sharing knowledge and solutions with society, following the development of cultural intelligence, has the potential to provide legitimacy and improve the quality of popular participation. The study concludes that combining knowledge management practices and organizational intelligence, with a focus on cultural intelligence, is the most effective way to share and use collective knowledge to improve Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs).

title: Jugar y sentir: ayudas didácticas para fortalecer la inteligencia emocional en la primera infancia Playing and feeling: educational aids to strengthen emotional intelligence in early childhood Brincar e sentir: recursos didáticos para fortalecer a inteligência emocional na primeira infância
abstract: Este artículo de revisión analiza los aportes teóricos y empíricos sobre el fortalecimiento de la inteligencia emocional en la primera infancia, a partir del uso de materiales educativos sustentados en el juego. Se desarrolló bajo un enfoque cualitativo de tipo documental, mediante la revisión de fuentes publicadas entre 2019 y 2025 en bases de datos como Scopus, SciELO, Dialnet y Redalyc. Se priorizaron estudios con un enfoque educativo, en español e inglés, que abordaran la dimensión emocional desde la práctica pedagógica. El análisis permitió reconocer seis tendencias: la atención creciente al desarrollo emocional en los primeros años; el papel del juego educativo como mediador socioafectivo; la relevancia de los materiales contextualizados; la influencia de los enfoques pedagógicos contemporáneos, la formación emocional del maestro y el avance de estudios latinoamericanos y colombianos. En conjunto, los hallazgos confirman que educar con emoción es posible cuando el maestro enseña con sensibilidad y propósito; el juego y los recursos didácticos se convierten entonces en puentes que nutren el corazón y la mente.

title: Realidad aumentada. Estrategia para resolución de problemas en Ciencias Naturales, quinto grado Augmented reality. Problem-solving strategy in Natural Sciences, fifth grade Realidade aumentada. Estratégia de resolução de problemas em Ciências Naturais, quinto ano
abstract: The research is based on the premise that augmented reality (AR) facilitates the understanding of complex scientific concepts and meaningful learning. Its objective was to strengthen problem-solving skills in the natural sciences of fifth-grade students at the Ignacio Gil Sanabria Institution in the municipality of Siachoque-Boyacá through the implementation of a teaching sequence on pollution. The results, generated from surveys and observation, were compared between the initial diagnosis and a post-test, and validated with statistical analysis and theoretical triangulation. The results demonstrate a significant impact on strengthening the problem-solving process in the area of natural sciences, consistent with the proposed objective. The students not only gained a clearer understanding of the abstract concepts inherent to the discipline, but also showed greater motivation and commitment to learning, key elements in the development of scientific thinking. Furthermore, the application of AR as a teaching resource favored content retention and its transfer to practical situations. Thus, it is demonstrated that the use of immersive technologies not only improves conceptual understand

title: Las Emociones en Contextos Educativos: perspectivas, desafíos y aportaciones críticas The Emotions in Educational Contexts: Perspectives, Challenges, and Critical Contributions As emoções em contextos educativos: perspetivas, desafios e contribuições críticas
abstract: This article invites reflection on the growing prominence of emotions in contemporary educational discourse. Through a review of recent academic literature, consulted in databases such as Scopus, Dialnet, Redalyc, and Google Scholar, the main perspectives addressing the emotional dimension in school contexts are examined. A strong psychological approach is identified, focused on the development of emotional competencies in teachers, students, and teachers in training. However, sociological and anthropological perspectives also emerge that challenge this individualizing view, proposing to understand emotions as social constructs, influenced by cultural, relational, and structural factors. It is noted that the practice of emotional education is not a neutral process; the current emphasis on emotions responds to specific interests and is nourished by other ideological frameworks that actively participate in the production of desirable subjectivities. From this perspective, there is an urgent need for teachers to take a critical stance towards proposals that are presented as universal solutions or pedagogical panaceas.

title: Solving problems in students with ASD and ADHD: Spain and Ecuador PROBLEMS IN STUDENTS WITH ASD AND ADHD Resolución de problemas en estudiantes con TEA y TDAH: España y Ecuador Resolução de problemas em alunos com TEA e TDAH: Espanha e Equador
abstract: The study examines the difficulty of math problem-solving in ASD and ADHD students in Spain and Ecuador and the influence of the learning context on test performance. The objectives are to define the patterns of difficulty, measure the effect of pedagogical interventions, and provide evidence-based recommendations for improvement. A quantitative comparative-relational study with a cross-sectional design was employed. 600 students (300 in each country) and 100 teachers were randomly selected using non-probabilistic sampling. title: Factores y atribuciones en las vocaciones científicas de los investigadores en México Factors and attributions in the scientific vocations of researchers in Mexico
abstract: This work is based on the project, "Scientific vocations and training of educational researchers." How do you decide to pursue a career in science in Mexico? Its objective is to reveal the main scientific vocations of researchers based on various factors and attributes. In this project, a correlational and descriptive quantitative method was applied to a non-probabilistic, intentional sample of 1,246 Mexican scientists. The questionnaire (multiple choice) obtained information that was processed using SPSS version 28. The results highlight the male gender in educational research in Mexico in terms of economic factors. Meanwhile, the female gender surpasses the male gender and the LGBTIQ community in terms of personal satisfaction and the attributes considered necessary and enjoyable. The conclusion is that scientific vocations are influenced by various factors and attributes. In the field of scientific and educational research, the development of knowledge stands out, followed by economic aspects, personal benefits, and the improvement of the employment situation. title: Brechas en la educación digital: algoritmos, exclusión y colonialismo tecnológico en Latinoamérica Digital divide in education: algorithms, exclusion and technological colonialism in Latin American
abstract: This article analyzes the impact of the digital divide in rural and indigenous communities in relation to educational equity and the development of digital skills. Three dimensions are explored: access to technological infrastructure, digital literacy, and cultural adaptation of digital educational content. The mixed approach methodology combines the analysis of statistical data on connectivity and digital access with interviews with teachers and students in rural areas of Costa Rica, Mexico and Bolivia, the study also includes literature review of previous studies on the impact of algorithmic bias and dependence on foreign digital infrastructures. The results show the lack of access to the internet and technological devices in rural communities, significantly limiting opportunities for learning and participation in the digital economy, barriers such as the scarcity of materials in indigenous languages and the lack of teacher training in digital skills were identified. Likewise, the influence of technological colonialism on education is highlighted, as it depends on foreign platforms that are not adapted to local contexts. It concludes that the digital divide requires a comprehensi

title: Enseñanza de la polinización en Colombia: reflexiones críticas Teaching pollination in Colombia: critical reflections
abstract: The purpose of the following work was to analyze emerging trends in research texts on pollination teaching in Colombia. The methodology includes the review of primary studies accessible in Google Scholar, using keywords and inclusion and exclusion criteria. The data were analyzed with the ATLAS.ti software, and the qualitative results highlight the most used pedagogical approaches, the regions with the highest production of texts, the educational and biological problems addressed, and the multidisciplinary nature of the texts characterized between 1990 and 2022. The results show the scarce production of texts on the teaching of pollination, the importance of addressing the subject at different educational levels, the concern for the loss of pollinators and the need to understand pollination from a systemic dimension, which includes social, natural and cultural components, and not as a definition far from the reality of the Colombian context. It is hoped that, with the analysis of these texts, basic criteria will be established for future pedagogical proposals that deal with the teaching of pollination in Colombia.

title: Procedimientos metodológicos para la elaboración de una reseña Methodological procedures for preparing a reviewaring a review.
abstract: The purpose of this article is to communicate the results obtained from an investigation on the concept of review, considering sources of general information and contrasting the concepts found to obtain a clear vision of said concept. It also seeks as its main objective to provide the reader a concept of the authors with the purpose of filling in eggs found in the sources of information consulted and thus achieving providing the reader with the basic skills for creating a critical review and finally applying the concept of critical review of the authors towards a article of your choice to put into practice the developed concept, its characteristics and style when reviewing.

title: Percepciones de los profesores de posgrado sobre la inteligencia artificial generativa Graduate faculty perceptions of generative artificial intelligence.
abstract: The present study seeks to understand the perceptions about generative artificial intelligence of graduate teachers and how these ideas may influence the adoption of such technology in their teaching practice. To this end, 50 articles are analyzed using the literature review method, resulting in three main ideas to consider. The first is the recognition of the potential of generative AI as a tool capable of boosting and making more efficient some activities within the teaching practice. The second important idea is the concern about biases and lack of regulations to conduct the use of this technology in an ethical manner and without the risk of plagiarism or major misconduct within the academic sector. Finally, the importance of both theoretical and practical training of teachers in generative AI tools is mentioned, in order to make possible the implementation of these tools in their practice from a critical and responsible thinking.

title: Análisis de propuestas para la apropiación de IA generativa en educación superior Analysis of proposals for the appropriation of generative AI in higher education.
abstract: Currently, artificial intelligence (AI) has been the focus of debate in many fields, and education has been no exception. In the midst of the proliferation, debates and positions have arisen regarding the implementation of these technologies for academic activities. Beyond the optimistic and pessimistic positions, few implementation proposals take into account the educational models and application contexts in their formulation. Therefore, this paper, from the content analysis of a corpus of manuals, guides and proposals for the implementation of generative artificial intelligence in higher education, sought to identify whether these proposals are based on pedagogical objectives and meet the needs of specific educational projects or whether their implementation has to do with the popularity of technologies and omit to identify a clear pedagogical purpose, in addition to exploring how they address the ethical issue and conceive the biases of these tools.

title: Formación de profesores para el uso de Inteligencia Artificial generativa Teacher training for the use of generative Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This experiential research explores the training of university professors for the pedagogical integration of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI). To conduct the study, we designed an online course aimed at developing competencies for the ethical, critical, creative, and formative use of AI. Based on the narratives of the participating professors, we identified that, prior to the course, many were unfamiliar with generative technologies, and only a few had incorporated such tools into their teaching practices. After completing the course, the professors demonstrated the ability to integrate AI into their pedagogical approaches, exploring its potential to foster co-authorship and critical reflection among students. The study concludes that higher education is being reshaped by generative technologies and that teacher training is essential for promoting the development of a new pedagogy that effectively integrates generative AI into educational practices.

title: Estudio comparativo sobre la implementación de estrategias neuroeducativas en el pensamiento crítico Comparative study on the implementation of neuroeducational strategies in critical thinking
abstract: This article analyzes the application of neurodidactic models in different international contexts, with a special focus on Costa Rica, highlighting the transformative potential of these methodologies based on advances in neuroscience. Through a comparison with countries such as Denmark, Switzerland, Norway, Japan and China, the characteristics, policies and results obtained in education systems that have adopted neuroeducational approaches are examined. The study also proposes research that incorporates simulated statistical data to explore the relationship between the implementation of neurodidactics and academic performance in these countries, which would allow the identification of good practices applicable to the Costa Rican context. It seeks to provide a solid basis for the development of innovative educational policies that improve both the quality of teaching and the emotional and cognitive well-being of students. The analysis is based on recent research and international academic sources, with the aim of formulating practical recommendations based on scientific evidence for the Costa Rican education system.

title: Posibilidades y desafíos de la Educación 4.0 en contextos de educación superior Possibilities and challenges of Education 4.0 in higher education contexts.
abstract: It is postulated that digital technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) are cultural artifacts of a given socio-historical moment. Thus understood, technologies make sense in education when they manage to transform the mentalities and sociocultural practices of the actors. In the context of the so-called Fourth Industrial Revolution, Education 4.0 emerges, which promotes the pedagogical use of artificial intelligence systems, robotic technologies, augmented reality, immersive scenarios or data analytics, among other developments, to change the prevailing educational paradigm and join the efforts for a sustainable and egalitarian society. This has an impact on the emergence of new professions and on the rethinking of professional training models in the university context, as well as on the performance in the world of work or in the teaching task. The importance of sustaining these transformations from a disruptive view of the status quo is postulated, through an orientation towards goals of sustainable development, social justice and rights. title: Retroalimentación y ChatGPT en la educación superior. Revisión sistemática de literatura Feedback and ChatGPT in Higher Education: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: Currently, generative artificial intelligence has gained importance due to its use in feedback, particularly in universities. At the same time, it has sparked a debate about its influence on pedagogical dynamics. This systematic review seeks to provide insights into the discussion by evaluating the impact of ChatGPT in three key dimensions: students' academic training, teaching practices, and assessment. The PRISMA methodology was followed to select and analyze studies in Spanish (2019-2024) from SciELO, Redalyc, and Dialnet. The review included research evaluating automated feedback in higher education. The findings show that ChatGPT enhances content comprehension and promotes autonomy in structured disciplines but has limitations in fostering reflective analysis and logical argumentation. In teaching, it improves time management by reducing repetitive inquiries, although it still requires pedagogical mediation. In assessment, it is precise in identifying formal errors but lacks accuracy in conceptual judgments. title: Discalculia. Nichos y tendencias investigativas en América Latina y España Dyscalculia. Research niches and trends in Latin America and Spain
abstract: Dyscalculia is a difficulty in learning mathematics in relation to performing arithmetic operations, interpreting quantities, and understanding mathematical concepts. The article aims to analyze the research balance on dyscalculia in different national and international publications. Consequently, 53 articles were selected from the Redalyc, DOAJ, and Scopus databases. The study was conducted using an analytical and critical approach with the use of bibliometric techniques and an interpretive analysis with content analysis techniques. Four (4) indicators were analyzed using bibliometrics (temporal evolution, concentration and dispersion by academic journals and authors, and keyword analysis), finding that a large part of the authors and academic areas are part of the health field, Brazil stands out as a pioneer in dyscalculia research in Latin America. With regard to the interpretive/qualitative analysis, five (5) categories were identified: teacher training, diagnosis and assessment, effects on learning processes, dyscalculia and comorbidities, and intervention, highlighting the importance of early diagnosis and the lack of knowledge among mathematics teachers about dyscalculia.

title: Formación Integral: Desarrollando Proyectos de Vida y Paz. Integral Formation: Developing Life and Peace Projects.
abstract: In compliance with Article 73-Law 115 of 1994, I.E. Ginebra La Salle, in order to comply with regulations and strengthen training in civic competencies, proposes a comprehensive training project based on seven pillars that influence institutional values, contributing to the construction of a meaningful society with social cohesion. The objective is to design an institutional plan that trains well-rounded citizens with democratic principles who respond to the needs of their environment.Using a mixed approach, combining participation, collaboration, co-responsibility, horizontality, diversity, and critical reflection from the educational community and key actors in the region. The findings present key considerations related to improving civics and urbanity, respectful practices towards animals, promoting aculture of peace, suggestions for road safety education, encouraging entrepreneurship, the importance of creating a life project, and promoting ethnic diversity. title: A Feminist History of Science: Carolyn Merchant and The Death of Nature
abstract: This paper aims to contribute to existing bibliographical references on the history of science in the Brazilian context by presenting a new perspective, an example of historical pluralism. Through a feminist lens, we introduce, in this paper, insights offered by the American historian of science, Carolyn Merchant, in The Death of Nature: Ecology, Women and the Scientific Revolution. Despite its limited recognition in Brazilian universities, Merchant’s book serves as an exemplary piece of counter-history in science. Thus, we articulate the perspectives of diverse feminist thinkers in the realm of science, delve into their critiques, and expound upon the ideas presented by Carolyn Merchant.

title: Inclusión educativa e infancias migrantes en Colombia Educational inclusion and migrant children in Colombia
abstract: Since 2015, Venezuelan migration to Colombia has accentuated exclusion practices as a result of social aporophobia. This article carries out a content analysis of documents issued by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (Unesco), dealing with the inclusion of children in education. At the national level, documents formulated by government institutions for the attention of foreign population in educational institutions are related. The purpose of the conceptual relationship was to consider the official discourses regarding the underlying realities given the migration in crisis of the Venezuelan people, specifically, within the school field. The content analysis allowed determining that Venezuelan migration in Colombia is understood as a strategy of social accommodation, using the capital obtained in their migratory trajectory and their interests to obtain favorable living conditions and the search for social recognition.

title: Currículo: ¿Un reflejo de la sociedad o un motor de cambio? Curriculum: A reflection of society or a driver of change?
abstract: This article explores the nature of the curriculum, examining whether it acts primarily as a reflection of society or as an engine of change. Through an exhaustive documentary analysis and a qualitative approach, the historical, cultural and philosophical foundations of the curriculum are analyzed, evidencing the need for an education that promotes the formation of critical citizens committed to their environment. An analysis of bibliographic case studies is presented, as well as the results of the evaluation of the implementation of the Earth Charter in six (6) Venezuelan schools, as empirical evidence of the dichotomy between the written and the learned curriculum. The research highlights the importance of considering the social, cultural, political and pedagogical dimensions of the curriculum, and proposes a more flexible and relevant approach to respond to current challenges. title: Desafíos en la formación docente bajo el contexto de la inteligencia artificial The role of the teacher training in teacher training in the context of artificial intelligence
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in education raises important questions about how teaching methodologies should be adapted, the needs for the education of the future and the approach to initial and continuing teacher training. This study aimed to understand the possibilities and challenges of initial and continuing teacher training in the context of artificial intelligence, from the discourses of teachers in the Metropolitan Region. A qualitative approach was used, employing focus groups and semi-structured interviews, within a phenomenological-hermeneutic perspective. The findings indicated that the main challenges in teacher training linked to AI include the need for comprehensive digital education, the development of 21st century skills, the ethical understanding of AI and its limitations, as well as pedagogical and curricular innovation. The importance of creating institutional arrangements to facilitate continuing education was also identified. In addition, the study highlighted the key role of teachers as mediators between generative AI tools and pedagogical practices, promoting effective and responsible integration.

title: Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en el fortalecimiento del trabajo colaborativo Generative Artificial Intelligence in the strengthening of Collaborative Work
abstract: In an educational context where individualized teaching is prioritized and the information provided by Generative Artificial Intelligence (AGI) algorithms tend to represent dominant points of view, limiting plural narratives, the role of educators in designing learning strategies that foster participation, creativity, and critical thinking through collaboration is fundamental. This study aimed to analyze and reflect on the results of postgraduate students' practicum experiences in implementing didactic strategies grounded in collaborative work, utilizing GAI resources in their design. Employing a qualitative methodology through the systematization of experiences and discourse analysis, this research was conducted within the framework of the Education and Technology seminar of the Doctorate in Educational Management and Public Policy at the Universidad Autónoma de Zacatecas, Mexico. The results showed to ChatGPT as the most widely used technology through chatbots and text creators, an increase in motivation and a sense of collaboration in students, along with opportunities for improvement in teacher training and development.

title: Los metalenguajes de la Inteligencia Artificial en la formación universitaria contemporánea The metalanguages of artificial intelligence in contemporary university education
abstract: University education in the 21st century incorporates science, technology, advanced methods and techniques, coming from specific areas of knowledge that impact professional performance, in order to make each of the substantive processes that comprise it more efficient. In the specific academic component, marked by teaching in connection with research, educational innovation processes and the introduction of scientific results, the inclusion of applications of artificial intelligence (AI) is a majority trend, hence the need to investigate and reflect on the relationship of AI with didactics. Contents. Contemporary university education: reality and development perspectives in its link with AI; Computer metalanguages: potential to support the teacher's work; Applications of AI: contemporary learning tools. Conclusions. AI can contribute to the improvement of higher education, if the teacher knows the challenges it implies, for the ethical use of it that allows students to achieve higher levels of self-development.

title: Propuesta de guía didáctica para la capacitación docente en el uso de IA Proposal of a didactic guide for teacher training in the use of AI
abstract: El presente artículo parte de un análisis de la visión y retos sobre la capacitación docente, así como del uso de la inteligencia artificial (IA), en el ámbito educativo, para ofrecer una propuesta/modelo de capacitación en ingeniería de prompts y el uso ético de la IA. Se da inicio con una breve revisión del estado del arte de la forma en cómo se concibe el uso de la inteligencia artificial en la educación y de la importancia de la formación docente; para sustentar el hecho de que es necesario promover nuevas formas de trabajo, centradas en la alfabetización digital, que permitan a los docentes gestionar las herramientas de conocimiento que los lleven a enfrentar de forma asertiva, la nueva ola de uso de la inteligencia artificial, que nace con el lanzamiento de ChatGPT, en noviembre de 2022. Se concluye con la presentación de una guía para el uso asertivo de la IA en el contexto educativo, destacando la necesidad de no solo adquirir conocimiento sobre las especificaciones y uso de estas herramientas, sino sobre las implicaciones éticas y marcos normativos de regulación. title: Marco curricular de educación media superior en México: una escuela abierta y orientadora Curriculum Framework for Upper Secondary Education in Mexico: An Open and Guiding School
abstract: El objetivo de esta investigación es analizar la incorporación del modelo de escuela abierta y orientadora en el Marco Curricular Común de educación media superior en México, en el proyecto educativo de la Nueva Escuela Mexicana, que pugna por una educación de excelencia y con justicia social. El análisis se realizó a través de una revisión de los elementos curriculares donde se encontró que a partir de sus dos grandes componente, el currículo fundamental y currículo el ampliado, se decanta la construcción de una cultura democrática alternativa, la cual gira en torno al modelo de escuela abierta y orientadora, que pondera la dimensión ética-política de la educación. Se concluye que este modelo dota de identidad al estudiante como agente prepolítico de su comunidad. Las áreas de conocimiento y recursos sociocognitivos y socioemocionales propician la interconexión entre aula, escuela y comunidad que había estado ausente en los marcos curriculares neoliberales.
